cc:Work.dc:title: Game - MiniatureWorkshop
cc:Work.dc:description:
Pick a main character, up to two optional pets and a base -- get one board with all pieces laid out ready to laser in a single job.
Combines pre-drawn miniature artwork (main character, up to two optional pets, base) into a single laser-ready board. Each piece keeps the colors it was authored with; run boxes.generators.miniature.svgscan over an asset folder to check those colors against this app's cut/etch palette before trusting a new file.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes MiniatureWorkshop Command line short: boxes MiniatureWorkshop

text.style: font-family: sans-serif ; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; fill: rgb(0,0,255)
